title: Quiz Easy
description: Built with Next.js 14, this full-stack quiz platform uses the Google Gemini API to generate interactive quizzes. It supports multiple-choice and open-ended gameplay, real-time scoring, and quiz history. Prisma with PostgreSQL powers data modeling, while NextAuth handles authentication; the app is deployed on Vercel.

title: Cloud Share
description: Built a full-stack file management platform with React.js and Spring Boot, supporting secure uploads and downloads with a public/private visibility toggle. Spring Security and Clerk authentication protect user accounts and isolate private directories. Razorpay powers premium subscriptions with server-side order creation, payment verification, and transaction history logging. MongoDB stores file metadata and supports efficient retrieval and secure, unique share links for public files.
role: React.js · Spring Boot · MongoDB · Spring Security · Clerk · Razorpay
